source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Sorry—given that MeetAlfred seems to allow new leads to be added only to existing campaigns, do you know how to use Zapier to create a brand-new Campaign in MeetAlfred by importing leads from Hubspot?

value_updates.desired_workflow: Create a brand-new MeetAlfred campaign and configure Zapier to import leads from HubSpot.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: Selecting an existing campaign is allowed, but no option appears for creating a new campaign in MeetAlfred.

execution.observed_behavior: Zapier allowed selection of an existing MeetAlfred campaign but exposed no option for creating a new campaign.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: First, create a new campaign in meet alfred, then set up a zapp that pushes leads through Hubspot. For the new setup, you can duplicate the existing zapps and change only their names.

value_updates.campaign_creation_method: Create the new campaign directly in MeetAlfred before configuring Zapier.
value_updates.zap_setup_method: Duplicate an existing Zap and rename it for the new campaign.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
1\. Made a copy of the Zap
2\. In MeetAlfred, created a new campaign named Enterprise Design Studios
3\. Configured that new Zap accordingly, then published it

execution.observed_behavior: The client copied an existing Zap, created a new MeetAlfred campaign, configured the copied Zap for it, and published the Zap.

routing_warnings.description: The unchanged MeetAlfred lead count concerns whether HubSpot leads synchronize into an existing campaign, not campaign provisioning.
The new campaign showing zero leads is a lead-synchronization failure rather than a failure to create the campaign or configure its Zap.
The distinction between preexisting and newly added HubSpot leads concerns synchronization trigger behavior.
The successful test with a newly added lead and failure for preexisting leads belong to the lead-synchronization Requirement.
